display_name: MiniMax H3 Image to Video + Audio (8-step quality)
description: Image-to-video WITH native audio (dialogue, SFX, ambience generated together) from a first frame. real camera parallax, legible on-screen text, character stays on-model. MiniMax H3 FL2VA pruned int8 + 8-step turbo LoRA. For finals when the 4-step shows artifacts: ~4-6 min per 5s clip. ~44GB system RAM at peak: Needs at least 18 GB of swap active (the run refuses otherwise) and nothing else on the GPU; stop Chatterbox/ACE/Qwen-TTS first. 24fps, frames snap up to 5+17n (124=~5s, 243=~10s, 362=15s max). Width/height must match the input image aspect (it is stretched). Prompt: style line, then SHOT lines describing motion, dialogue as (S1): <d>[English] words</d>, end with an 'Audio:' line. Audio loudness varies clip to clip (-31 to -16 dB): loudnorm before mixing. Long jobs return status 'running': poll get_job_result with wait_seconds.

prompt.description: Style line + SHOT-by-SHOT motion + dialogue as (S1): <d>[English] words</d> + final 'Audio:' line

width.description: Video width (multiple of 32), same aspect as the input

height.description: Video height (multiple of 32), same aspect as the input

frames.description: Frame count at 24fps, snapped up to 5+17n (124=~5s, 243=~10s, 362=15s)

steps.description: Sampling steps (8 matches the turbo LoRA)
